hotfix_objectives_serializer.root_cause: Serializer shape mismatch: DB stores objectives as {title, kind, rule} (new authoring format) but UI expects {text, validator:{kind,value}}
hotfix_objectives_serializer.fix: arcade_app/quest_helper.py::_normalize_objectives() — maps title->text, kind->validator.kind, rule.pattern->validator.value. Supports all three DB shapes transparently.

incident_objectives_ui_blank_rows.symptom: Objectives count correct (e.g. '0/2') but rows render as empty shells in QuestDrawer. QuestIDE validator checks all fail silently.
incident_objectives_ui_blank_rows.root_cause: Phase Debt-2 backfill wrote objectives in new format {title, kind, rule:{pattern}}. quest_to_dict() returned them raw; QuestDrawer reads obj.text (undefined in new format) giving blank content nodes.
fix: Backend: _normalize_objectives() in arcade_app/quest_helper.py normalizes title->text, kind->validator.kind, rule.pattern->validator.value at serialization time.
Frontend: QuestDrawer.tsx falls back to obj.text || obj.title with DEV-mode diagnostic badge showing kind when text is missing.
prevention: tests/test_objectives_serializer_shape.py — 12 tests + named incident test covering old format passthrough, new format normalization, all 5 kinds, and edge cases.
scripts/audit_objectives_shape.py — live DB scan added to CI, flags blank text or malformed validator objects.
docs/OBJECTIVE_CONTRACT.md — single source of truth for all three DB shapes and the stable API contract.
